answer.content:
I understand you'd like a camera instead of the Bookshelf from your order. However, I'm unable to make that change for you.

If an item can be modified or exchanged, it can only be changed to another item of the same product type (for example, a Bookshelf to another Bookshelf with different options) — we can't change a Bookshelf to a different product type like a camera. Additionally, your order #W5362037 is in "processed" status, so it isn't eligible for modification (which requires a pending order) or exchange (which requires a delivered order), and it also can't be cancelled at this point.

As a result, there's no way to swap the Bookshelf for a camera on this order. Is there anything else I can help you with?
